restaurant_name: FUN TIME Dental Clinic คลินิกทันตกรรมฟันไทม์
text:
Just been today, for 2 fillings. Made the apt. 4 weeks ago based on the Google reviews. Coming from the UK, we live in a dental desert, where it is impossible to get an apt. I saw the gentleman Dr. who was the most welcoming and friendly dentist I have ever visited. "The happy dentist", as he was due a day or 2 off at the weekend.

He filled one cavity and virtually rebuilt another tooth, the Dr. and his assistant were excellent and did a very professional job. In fact he recommended that I make another apt. for a thorough clean before I return home next week, which I have done. If anyone is ever in the Cha-Am / Hua Hin area and needs some dental work doing this is the practice to visit. 6 stars, spot on.

restaurant_name: FUN TIME Dental Clinic คลินิกทันตกรรมฟันไทม์
text:
There are many reasons to give this clinic a 5-star rating, not least of which is their clever word play - “fun” being the Thai word for “teeth” :) I’m the last person to think visiting the dentist constitutes a “fun time” but, seriously, this place has done wonders to dissipate a lifelong neurotic fear of dental work. The receptionist squeezed me in for an emergency procedure — so empathetic, kind and patient over the phone. Dr. Saran treated me with equal care and consideration. In less than half an hour I was relieved of my pain, x-rayed to ensure no lingering issues, and given a clear plan for next steps accounting for travel plans etc. Super professional, super efficient, super affordable. Feeling so fortunate to have found Fun Time! Wish I could give more than 5 stars. Thank youuuuu!

Update: I had the opportunity to get a cleaning done by the clinic’s charismatic owner, Dr. James - aka the singing dentist :) okaaay… I will now happily say there IS such a thing as having a Fun Time at the dentist.  Dr. James put me at ease, explained every single procedure, had the gentlest hands, and gave practical oral care advice on practically every tooth I still own. Highest praise for the entire staff including Ja who answers the phone and juggles appointments and doctors’ schedules like a rock star.
